alerts.title: Adnoc Confirms Strike on Tanker in UAE's Territorial Waters
alerts.why: Attacks on UAE tankers in the Hormuz shuttle route threaten critical crude supply chokepoints, driving significant geopolitical risk premiums into Brent.

alerts.title: Oil Prices Rise as Iran Peace Optimism Fades
alerts.why: Geopolitical instability in the Strait of Hormuz increases supply risk premiums, offsetting previous optimism regarding potential Iranian supply returning to the market.

itemsSent.title: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
itemsSent.why: Higher-than-expected inflation increases the likelihood of sustained high interest rates, strengthening the dollar and pressuring oil demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: October’s firm inflation reading raises the question of whether Federal Reserve officials will accelerate increases at their December meeting or beyond.
itemsSent.why: Firm inflation reading raises prospects of tighter Fed policy, pressuring economic growth and crude demand.

itemsSent.title: Recent Ukrainian Attacks Have Reduced Russia’s Oil Processing Capacity By 30%, Sources Say
itemsSent.why: Refinery damage cuts Russian crude demand (bearish CL) while tightening product supply, lifting refined products (bullish HO/RB/Gasoil).

itemsSent.title: Qatar LNG Loadings Pick Up to Around Half of Pre-War Levels
itemsSent.why: Qatar LNG loadings recovering toward half of pre-war levels eases severe supply concerns, pushing global natural gas prices down.

itemsSent.title: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan opens the door to a faster pace of hikes.
Average U.S. Gasoline Price Dips below $4 for First Time since July
Ukrainian Strikes Disrupt 30% of Russia's Oil Refining Capacity
itemsSent.why: Refinery strikes reduce domestic runs, bearish crude as feedstock builds, but bullish diesel and products due to disrupted exports.

itemsSent.title: Fed’s Waller says larger hike should be considered if October CPI runs hot
itemsSent.why: Hawkish Fed comments raise rate hike expectations, strengthening the dollar and dampening macroeconomic growth and oil demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: US Inflation Slows Down
itemsSent.why: Lower inflation expectations reduce pressure on the Fed to hike rates, supporting economic growth and oil demand sentiment.

itemsSent.title: Russia Warns Europe Against Interference With the Shadow Fleet
itemsSent.why: Threats of retaliation over shadow fleet tanker interference raise geopolitical risk premiums and potential supply disruption concerns in Europe.

itemsSent.title: Houthis Launch Another Attack on Pumping Stations Along Crucial Saudi East-West
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical risk premium rises as Houthi strikes target critical Saudi pipeline infrastructure and facilities, threatening Middle East supply stability.

itemsSent.title: Uncertainty Surrounds Possible Attack on Oman's Strait of Hormuz Lighthouse
itemsSent.why: Uncertainty over potential Iranian actions near the strategic Strait of Hormuz introduces minor geopolitical risk premium to Brent crude prices.
